name: Memory Consolidation
description: Nightly memory consolidation: gather sessions and the long-term store, triage honestly, prune and promote sparingly, rewrite the memory index, and review Deep Truths.
narrative: This is memory's own housekeeping, and it is exclusively about memory — ignore whatever other work is in flight. Gather the raw material first: recent sessions and the current long-term store, both the recent entries and the full archive. Triage it into what stays, what deserves promotion into durable memory, and what has gone stale and should be retired — then execute those retirements and promotions conservatively (a few high-value writes, never a flood). Rewrite the memory index so it reflects only what is still active. Finally, review whether any long-standing, well-evidenced fact has earned Deep-Truth status. The throughline: gather, triage honestly, prune and promote sparingly, keep the index true.
